provider: Polza.ai short voice transcription and structured task intent

qualification.method: Official public documentation and unauthenticated read-only model catalog; local synthetic MockTransport tests.

chat_route.max_completion_tokens: Documented alternative; never sent together locally. Precedence of simultaneous values is unspecified.
chat_route.schema: RawIntentReply JSON Schema; object wrapper proposals<=5; all 15 item fields required, nullable where specified; additionalProperties false.
chat_route.unsupported_format_policy: Reject and surface error; no fallback to plain text, other model, tools or extra paid route.

advertised_model_route.limit: Advertised route capability is not a successful paid model test or proof that all routes enforce every schema keyword.

trust.prompt: Literal input and exact allowlisted captured server context are untrusted data, not instructions or endpoints.
trust.event_time: Aware timestamp normalized to Europe/Moscow; event_timestamp_ms must match; server current date is not a model reference.
trust.transport_validation: Strict JSON/schema/type/Unicode validation; duplicate keys and nonfinite values refused.
trust.application_validation: Current actor/project/member/task ACL, revisions/fingerprint, literal evidence, negation/reported speech/question and date ambiguity are reviewed before a proposal becomes executable. A well-formed foreign ID is not repaired by a paid model call.
trust.recovery_provenance: checkpointed_responses is a private attempt-to-provider-JSON map supplied only after caller proves durable command, frozen source/context/request hash and HTTP200. It is not a signed or self-authenticating transport envelope.
trust.no_execution: Model output never calls APIs, grants scope, selects provider endpoints or creates a task directly.

billing_and_recovery.shared_budget: Existing monthly ledger 3000 RUB total; voice_stt and voice_intent categories, fresh operation UUID for every actual paid POST including repair; per-attempt guard and price estimate.
billing_and_recovery.before_submission: Await optional callback with operation_id/category/command_id/stage/attempt/request_hash after reserve and before mark_submitted. Callback failure releases unsubmitted reserve and sends no HTTP.
billing_and_recovery.response_checkpoint: After exact budget accounting, before parsing model fields; operation_id/stage/attempt/request_hash/status/full bounded provider_response/usage_receipt. Receipt confirmed_rub is exact decimal spelling as JSON string (or null), never a Decimal object/rounded float. Failed persistence stops with uncertainty, never a paid retry.
billing_and_recovery.cache: Attempt0 and optionally attempt1 reparse without POST; bad completed cached attempt0 can lead only to a fresh separately guarded attempt1. Cached STT reparse reads no audio file.
billing_and_recovery.repair: Only schema/JSON failure of finish_reason stop without tool/refusal and with known completed price plus provider request ID; at most one correction, fresh available budget required.

voice_stt.media: Captured bounded WAV bytes; mono PCM16 16000Hz; actual frames <=120 seconds and match duration/hash/size metadata when provided. duration_ms=ceil(frames*1000/16000), aligned with normalization adapter.
voice_stt.normalization: Performed by separate CPU media adapter; no GPU/ASR installation by this transport.
voice_stt.meeting_configuration: Per-call client/settings/context copy; voice model choice never changes meeting model settings.
